stage0054_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$トライア$$
「...That's everything I know about
　the $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0054_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Sorry to trouble you, Dr. $$トライア$$.
　I made you play both sides between
　the Federation and Neo Zeon.」

stage0054_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$トライア$$
「Don't worry about it.
　Personally, I'm not all that
　interested in how the war goes.」

stage0054_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$トライア$$
「That said, I hate trouble.
　If what I told you makes you want
　to end this war, all the better.」

stage0054_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$トライア$$
「Fine.
　I never expected it anyway.」

stage0054_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$トライア$$
「Though if he were here, he'd go
　stop you without a thought for profit.」

stage0054_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Indeed.
　If he were in this world too,
　he'd have joined the $c.」

stage0054_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$トライア$$
「Anyway, the data you got earlier from
　the Federation $$大統領$$ was genuine, right?」

stage0054_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$トライア$$
「That person and the people around them
　are seriously trying to end this war
　through talks. Give them credit for that.」

stage0054_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I understand their sincerity.
　But the $$大統領$$ isn't the same as
　the Earth Federation as an organization.」

stage0054_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the complicated talk.
　I don't want to rack my brain over that.」

stage0054_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$トライア$$
「Anyway, I've told you everything I know.
　If you want this world to keep going,
　then think it through before you act.」

stage0054_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シャア$$
「The future of the world, huh...」

stage0054_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シャア$$
「And for that, I can't avoid this war...」

stage0054_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Right on time...
　Very well, $$フル・フロンタル$$. Let's hear your plan.」

stage0054_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アルト$$
「Our mission is to keep Neo Zeon in check, huh...」

stage0054_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$, now $$シャア・アズナブル$$ again,
　has special feelings for Captain $$アムロ$$.」

stage0054_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If we keep poking around like this,
　something's bound to happen.」

stage0054_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ルカ$$
「If we could learn his true intent there
　and bring about a ceasefire, that'd be ideal...」

stage0054_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カイエン$$
「According to Commander $$レディ・アン$$,
　the details of this whole affair were
　reported to Neo Zeon by the Federation $$大統領$$.」

stage0054_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カイエン$$
「If they won't end the war even then,
　meeting this $$シャア$$ won't likely mean a ceasefire.」

stage0054_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「That thing about $$シャア・アズナブル$$ and
　Captain $$アムロ$$'s special feelings, tell me more!」

stage0054_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クラン$$
「That's the part you latch onto!?」

stage0054_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$サザンカ$$ never wavers, even in a world crisis.」

stage0054_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's fine.
　The world is the world, a person's a person.」

stage0054_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「We're fighting as $c while still
　living our student lives, after all.」

stage0054_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Hmm... enjoying your private life that much?」

stage0054_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa! It's $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

stage0054_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$シェリル$$
「No complaining.
　Escorting us to the fleet is
　your job too, you know.」

stage0054_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, $$アルト$$.
　We always barge in on you so suddenly.」

stage0054_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「No... I don't think that at all.
　If someone's trying to use your songs,
　I can't just leave that alone.」

stage0054_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You're so sweet to $$ランカ$$.」

stage0054_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about, $$シェリル$$?
　I said 'your songs', plural.」

stage0054_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Of course I plan to protect you too.」

stage0054_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Nice one, $$アルト$$.
　That straightforward kindness you
　show sometimes really gets me.）

stage0054_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アンディ$$
（Did you see that, $$アマタ$$!
　The Galactic Fairy melted in an instant!）

stage0054_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「What are you two sneaking around for...!
　That's indecent of you!」

stage0054_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Ms. $$シェリル$$, Ms. $$ランカ$$...!
　Guarding you two is our duty, but
　you'll follow the rules on this ship.」

stage0054_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You two may be victims yourselves, but
　your presence disrupts the squad's discipline.」

stage0054_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Isn't that just... everyone being
　honest with their own hearts?」

stage0054_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シェリル$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$... why not be honest with your
　own heart too? Stay too stiff and your
　heart will stiffen up as well.」

stage0054_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　$$シェリル$$'s got a point!」

stage0054_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Q, quiet!
　Look at you, going soft on $$シェリル$$!」

stage0054_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シェリル$$
（Oh... I only meant to tease her, but
　that might've been a nice assist...）

stage0054_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Setting the discipline issue aside,
　things really do feel livelier when
　Ms. $$シェリル$$ and Ms. $$ランカ$$ visit.」

stage0054_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「There's been so much going on lately,
　thinking about what's ahead, it's a lot...」

stage0054_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$ミコノ$$ today...?」

stage0054_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I haven't seen her since earlier...」

stage0054_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$モロイ$$
「There's a stowaway!
　$$ミコノ$$'s been caught by them!」

stage0054_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Major $$オズマ$$! What's the situation!?」

stage0054_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$オズマ$$
「The intruder's holding $$ミコノ$$ hostage,
　hidden behind a machine. They must've
　snuck aboard $$ランカ$$'s $$シャトル$$ into the Quarter.」

stage0054_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$n
「Is it a terrorist targeting those two...!」

stage0054_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「No... the intruder's alone.
　This doesn't look like a planned attack.」

stage0054_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「And it seems they've been after
　$$ミコノ$$ alone from the very start.」

stage0054_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Finally caught you, you damn woman.」

stage0054_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Why are you doing this?
　Stowing away in space, even...」

stage0054_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Obviously.
　To settle things right in front of him.」

stage0054_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「'That guy'... you mean $$アマタ$$?」

stage0054_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's right.
　No idea why, but it's only with him
　I feel I have to settle things clean.」

stage0054_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I can smell it...
　You really do stink.」

stage0054_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Why...!
　Why do you keep saying such awful things!?」

stage0054_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Because I hate you...
　Because I want to kill you...」

stage0054_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Why...?
　I haven't done anything to you...」

stage0054_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「It's your fault for being on Vega.」

stage0054_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Then you should just kill me right here...」

stage0054_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「E, even I... can't... not in a place like this...!」

stage0054_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Come to think of it, Supreme Commander
　$$不動$$ called his power an inverted power...）

stage0054_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Could it be... when his emotions run high,
　what he says comes out inverted too...?）

stage0054_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Why...?
　These eyes... feel oddly nostalgic...）

stage0054_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$シルフィ$$... you called me that
　once before, too...」

stage0054_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$シルフィ$$ and $$アポロン$$...
　That's our myth.」

stage0054_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「This is... a Fire Bomber song!?」

stage0054_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Here I go!
　Liiisten to my song!!」

stage0054_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$シュレード$$,
　are you sure this will actually work?」

stage0054_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Who knows... we'll see, won't we?」

stage0054_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「What kind of man ARE you!!」

stage0054_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「The one holding Ms. $$ミコノ$$ hostage
　is probably that beast-like guy!
　Singing to someone like that won't...!」

stage0054_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$バサラ$$
「What's got you all so worked up?」

stage0054_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$バサラ$$
「He came to see the girl he loves, right?
　That's hot blooded!」

stage0054_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シュレード$$
「If someone has that kind of sensitivity,
　this song will surely shake their heart」

stage0054_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「OK!
　$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$, come on!」

stage0054_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Whoaaa!
　What is this?! My body's heating up!!」

stage0054_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's right!
　Keep getting hotter and hotter!!」

stage0054_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Waaaaugh!!
　$$シルフィ$$! I hate you so much!!」

stage0054_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Sorry, beast boy...
　It's a shame, but this Fire Bomber song
　turns to agitato from here」

stage0054_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Just a little added sound is enough
　to turn a sweet melody into one of death」

stage0054_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「There it is, $$シュレード$$'s Element
　ability, Mind Performance!」

stage0054_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Gah! So you came, scentless man!」

stage0054_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not handing $$ミコノ$$ over to you!」

stage0054_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That damn woman!
　I'm gonna kill her for sure!!」

stage0054_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you do that!」

stage0054_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Damn it! He and $$アマタ$$ are too close,
　I can't use my gun!」

stage0054_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「What are you talking about, $$バサラ$$!?」

stage0054_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$バサラ$$
「An enemy's an enemy, but a love rival!
　So let $$アマタ$$ handle it!」

stage0054_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（His eyes... so straight toward what he wants...）

stage0054_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You've gotten a bit better, huh!」

stage0054_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I will not hand $$ミコノ$$ over to you!」

stage0054_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Come, $$ミスラ・グニス$$!!
　I'll crush the lot of you at once!!」

stage0054_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（Is this... the nightmare vision
　$$カイエン$$ showed me...?）

stage0054_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（But it's only me here...!
　Neither $$アマタ$$ nor $$カイエン$$ is here...!）

stage0054_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「That's $$ミコノ$$...!
　Is that him next to her!?」

stage0054_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$ and him... two people bound
　together by fate...」

stage0054_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Is that thing over there EVOL...!?」

stage0054_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「No...! It looks similar,
　but it's not EVOL!」

stage0054_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then, that's...!
　The legendary Mythical Aquarion...!」

stage0054_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「On the world's first day, beneath the Tree of Life...
　The great Tree of Life ruled over those who live
　on the star, and the star's own life as well」

stage0054_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「In the war between two races, Wings of the sun woke,
　the Tree of Life was pollinated...
　But the flower bore no fruit, and withered away...」

stage0054_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But the mingling of water saved it...」

stage0054_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And then, 12,000 years later...
　when the 24,000-year-old tragedy struck again,
　the Wings of the sun saved the world by sacrifice...」

stage0054_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But those people didn't give up...」

stage0054_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... heh heh...
　I've already found the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$」

stage0054_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「O Wings of the sun, for 24,000 years...
　no, 120 million years of anger and sorrow,
　the time for you and I to clear it draws near」

stage0054_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I guess we have no choice but to
　fight the Vajra after all...」

stage0054_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アルト$$
「Did you find something out, $$ルカ$$?」

stage0054_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ルカ$$
「This is just a hypothesis for now, but
　could the Vajra here this time be a
　different swarm from the $$再世戦争$$ ones?」

stage0054_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$クラン$$
「I see...!
　They haven't forgotten humans, or given up on them,
　they just haven't fully understood us yet!」

stage0054_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Then, if we keep singing, someday...!」

stage0054_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シェリル$$
「The day they understand humanity
　will surely come!」

stage0054_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's right.
　The Vajra aren't $$バアル$$...
　they should be able to coexist with humans too」

stage0054_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But, is that okay?
　We've been beating down the ones that attack us...」

stage0054_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That's fine.
　The Vajra are one single organism as a whole,
　there's no concept of an individual among them」

stage0054_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So even if we fight the Vajra's soldiers,
　to the Vajra as one whole organism,
　it's just like losing a bit of hair」

stage0054_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「But there are people who worry
　about losing their hair, you know...」

stage0054_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$サザンカ$$...
　Let me tell you, I just have a wide forehead」

stage0054_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Oh, is that so.
　That's a relief!」

stage0054_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Haha... I guess I really was
　misunderstood after all...」

stage0054_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Thanks, $$ルカ$$.
　That's put my mind at ease」

stage0054_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ルカ$$
「No... I'll gather more data myself
　and prove this theory」

stage0054_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ランカ$$
「We'll do our best too,
　so we can be a bridge between Vajra and humanity」

stage0054_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アルト$$
「If that's the case, the Vajra coming
　is welcome, to a point」

stage0054_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$n
「The fact that the Vajra can Fold is
　proof the dimensional boundary isn't fixed」

stage0054_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「More importantly, it's the Altair Army!
　They're crossing dimensions into this
　world and attacking us!」

stage0054_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$カイエン$$
「If we use their technology,
　we might break the Prison of Time too」

stage0054_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$桂$$
「This is great...!
　The guys I thought were just trouble
　just turned into hope!」

stage0054_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アルト$$
「I know.
　That's exactly why we have to keep fighting」

stage0054_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$c to all hands.
　A large-scale Neo Zeon operation has been confirmed」

stage0054_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Their objective is believed to be
　the capture of Fifth Luna」

stage0054_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$キラ$$
「It's an asteroid used for resource mining」

stage0054_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We already have $$アクシズ$$ for resources,
　so why now...?」

stage0054_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Also, among the fleet joining the operation,
　the Neo Zeon flagship $$レウルーラ$$ was confirmed」

stage0054_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$c will change course
　and head for Fifth Luna.
　All hands, remain on standby, alert status」

stage0054_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$n
「To think even the Neo Zeon flagship
　is on the move...」

stage0054_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　Is he coming too...」

stage0054_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work today, Master $$バサラ$$.
　That was another great stage」

stage0054_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But that beast boy from Altair...
　he was really into Master $$バサラ$$'s sound」

stage0054_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Enemy, ally, none of that matters...!
　If the heart gets through, everyone burns hot!」

stage0054_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's strange, Master $$バサラ$$'s singing...
　A voice that shakes dimensions like a vibration,
　I've never heard of anything else like it」

stage0054_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So that's why it damages machines that
　use $$次元力$$ in their drive systems」

stage0054_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I've never once thought about hurting
　someone with my song...!」

stage0054_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand.
　It's simply a matter of the result」

stage0054_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, Master $$バサラ$$, just follow
　your heart and sing.
　That is my only wish」

stage0054_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「From today's stage with the beast boy,
　50 Z worth of Z-Chips were generated.
　I'll add these to the squad's stock」

stage0054_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Alright...!
　Let's get right to it then!!」

stage0054_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah! Stop!
　That doesn't mean you should sing here!!」

stage0054_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シェリル$$
「See you, $$ゼシカ$$.
　$$ランカ$$ and I are going with Supreme
　Commander $$不動$$ to the Frontier fleet」

stage0054_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I... got courage from Miss $$ゼシカ$$.
　Please do your best」

stage0054_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　This lets me put one thing to rest」

stage0054_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I know $$アマタ$$ likes $$ミコノ$$...
　But it's okay if I like $$アマタ$$ too, right...」

stage0054_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's admirable, Master $$ゼシカ$$.
　If I were human, that line alone
　would've pegged the meter in my chest」

stage0054_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You say 'if you were human', but
　you sound kinda robotic, you know」

stage0054_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Therefore, so as not to forget this,
　I intend to rewatch Master $$ゼシカ$$'s
　confession scene at least 10 times a day」

stage0054_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... as Z-Chip collection reference,
　I record the battlefield every time, you see」

stage0054_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, to grow Master $$ゼシカ$$'s fanbase,
　editing the confession scene and selling
　it on D-Trader across all worlds works too」

stage0054_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get to it today... Business, business!」
